orientation.top_of_map: north; the backwater is at the west (left), the open meadow and the way to the hedge at the east (right)
orientation.sun: LGT-riverbank-01 sun south-west (lower left); LGT-riverbank-02/03 sun west-north-west (left, slightly above centre), over the water, in the sister's eyeline
orientation.offscreen: the villa roofline and the church spire are background-only skyline elements beyond the map
orientation.note_en: camera positions in views[] are described relative to these landmarks; xy_m = xy x map_extent_m (origin top-left).

landmarks.name: the way across the field to the hedge
landmarks.name_en: the way across the field to the hedge

views.desc_en: eye-level wide shot from the sunlit meadow toward the sister's sitting place in the elm shade on the bank, the backwater glinting beyond
eye-level wide shot from the sister's sitting place down the grassy slope to the still reed-edged backwater, the pollarded willow on the right
low medium shot from the water's edge up the sloping bank to the sisters sitting under the elms
eye-level wide shot from the bank across the open meadow toward the far hedge, the way the white rabbit and Alice run
low close shot from the root-edged lip of the bank to the tall reeds and reedmace at the water's edge
eye-level medium shot along the waterline from the reeds to the pollarded willow leaning over the backwater
high oblique medium shot from under the southern elm's branches down onto the sitting place, daisies in the turf and a few dead leaves on the grass
high oblique medium shot from the pollarded willow's crown along the top of the bank to the northern elm, the meadow bright beyond
eye-level detail shot from the sitting place up into the northern elm's leaves, a single dead leaf falling
